obfuscation_indicators: substantial doubt as a going concern
risk_summary: The disclosure identifies substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern, reflecting significant historical losses, accumulated deficit, operational disruption, and dependence on future financing and business transformation. Although cash of $152.01 million and project collections are presented as mitigating factors, the strategy and financing assumptions remain uncertain and largely unquantified. Extensive boilerplate and forward-looking disclaimers dilute the specificity of the risk discussion.
